dct_description_sm: Raw data set on microplastic morphologies, sizes, and chemical identities used in the data analysis and publication of "Evidence of Microplastic Ingestion in Ringed Seals (Pusa hispida) from the Canadian Arctic". This study was conducted to understand the amount and types of microplastics retained in the stomachs of ringed seals from remote regions of the Canadian Arctic. The data set contains seal body measurements and collection locations, raw microplastic counts in seal stomachs and blanks, and blank corrected microplastic counts, morphologies, and polymer types. This data provides a baseline for future microplastic monitoring studies.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Evidence of Microplastic Ingestion in Ringed Seals (Pusa hispida) from the Canadian Arctic
